automotive-ev-battery.summary: EVgo is significantly expanding its charging infrastructure with over 500 new DC fast charging stalls across 90 shopping centers operated by Brixmor Property Group. automotive-ev-battery.title: Kia's larger electric van caught with less camo ahead of its 'big' debut

automotive-ev-battery.title: Survey Sunday: this is how Chinese EVs will make it to America

The survey results provide valuable perspective on American consumer sentiment toward Chinese automotive brands.

automotive-ev-battery.title: Jakarta Solidifies Role As Southeast Asian Fleet Electrification Epicenter At Busworld 2026
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Jakarta is establishing itself as the regional leader in electric transit fleet adoption across Southeast Asia, with momentum building around Busworld 2026 as a showcase for the region's electrification initiatives. automotive-ev-battery.title: Kite Magnetics secures A$2-million grant to scale Aeroperm motor core material

automotive-ev-battery.title: BYD Expands PH EV Lineup with Double Model Launch, Celebrates Sealion 6 Milestone
automotive-ev-battery.summary: BYD Cars Philippines marked the second anniversary of its popular Sealion 6 plug-in hybrid with a milestone celebration and announced the expansion of its EV lineup with multiple new model launches. The event highlighted strong market momentum for the brand in the Philippines.

automotive-ev-battery.title: Gas Stations are Changing Globally. How Has It Changed in Your Town? (Part 1: Asia)
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Major oil and energy companies are transforming traditional petrol station models globally as EV adoption accelerates, with companies like Total Energies, Shell, Sinopec, and Idemitsu adapting their infrastructure strategies. This analysis examines how Asia's fuel retail landscape is shifting in response to electrification trends.

world-news.title: Israel rejects Trump's 15-point plan for Gaza, Netanyahu says
world-news.summary: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has formally rejected a Trump administration proposal for Gaza, stating that Israeli military forces will not withdraw until Hamas is completely disarmed. This rejection signals a significant diplomatic impasse in ongoing peace negotiations and reflects a key geopolitical disagreement between Washington and Tel Aviv.

world-news.title: Iran war live: US 'semi-negotiating' with Tehran; Israel rejects Gaza plan
world-news.summary: The Trump administration is pursuing economic pressure on Iran while engaging in limited diplomatic channels, as Israel simultaneously rejects the administration's Gaza peace proposal. These parallel developments underscore heightened tensions in both Middle Eastern conflict zones and conflicting US strategic priorities.

world-news.title: Germany warns of 'daily hybrid warfare' after explosive-laden drone found
world-news.summary: Germany's interior minister has issued a warning of escalating hybrid warfare tactics including espionage, sabotage, and cyberattacks following the discovery of an explosive-laden drone near a military base. The incident reflects growing NATO and European security concerns over potential state-sponsored interference and infrastructure vulnerability.

world-news.title: Where does Iran stand on Saudi-Pakistan-Turkiye pact?
world-news.summary: Regional analysts assess Iran's position regarding a new trilateral security pact among Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, and Turkey, noting that Iran views the agreement's significance primarily through the lens of diminishing US regional influence. The pact represents a potential realignment of Middle Eastern geopolitical alliances with implications for broader regional stability.

world-news.title: What's driving unrest in Pakistan-administered Kashmir?
world-news.summary: Pakistan-administered Kashmir is experiencing its most significant political crisis in years, reflecting deep-seated tensions in one of Asia's most volatile disputed territories. The unrest carries implications for Pakistan-India regional relations and broader South Asian stability.

world-news.title: Can the Doha Framework end the conflict in eastern DRC?
world-news.summary: The Democratic Republic of Congo has handed over 15 prisoners to a powerful rebel alliance under the Doha Framework diplomatic initiative, marking a significant development in efforts to resolve the ongoing conflict in eastern Africa. The framework represents a multilateral approach to addressing the region's complex armed group dynamics and humanitarian crisis.

world-news.title: Union reports 108 attacks on Palestinian journalists in July
world-news.summary: The Palestinian Journalists Syndicate has documented 108 attacks on journalists during July, continuing a troubling trend of media suppression with over 270 journalists killed in Gaza since October 2023. The persistent targeting of journalists raises critical international press freedom and human rights concerns.

world-news.title: Drones spotted over German base days after Leipzig bomb incident
world-news.summary: German police are investigating drone sightings over a military base reportedly housing Patriot missile system components, occurring shortly after a separate bombing incident in Leipzig. The incidents raise escalating security concerns regarding potential foreign interference and critical NATO infrastructure vulnerability in Germany.

world-news.title: Ecuador charges ex-minister over presidential candidate assassination case
world-news.summary: Ecuadorian prosecutors have charged a former minister and accused five others, including a cartel leader, in connection with the murder of presidential candidate Fernando Villavicencio. The case reflects the deepening challenge of organized crime infiltration into Latin American political processes and judicial systems.

world-news.title: Evidence that South African special forces murdered top detective shared with BBC
world-news.summary: Evidence has emerged suggesting that South African special forces were responsible for the murder of top detective Frans Mathipa, with prosecution cases filed against eight accused military personnel. The case raises serious questions regarding state security force accountability and rule of law in South Africa.

science-space.title: The total solar eclipse on Aug. 12 will reveal something nobody has ever seen before
science-space.summary: A total solar eclipse occurring on August 12, 2026, will provide observers with a rare naked-eye view of the sun's outer atmosphere, or corona. science-space.title: Here's what to expect from 5 stages of the total solar eclipse 2026
science-space.summary: This guide details the five distinct phases of the August 12, 2026 total solar eclipse, from initial contact through totality to the final stages. Understanding these stages helps observers prepare for and safely experience this significant astronomical event.

science-space.title: NASA's SkyFall Helicopters at Work (Artist's Concept)
science-space.summary: NASA's SkyFall mission will deploy three advanced helicopters on Mars equipped with ground-penetrating radar and near-infrared imaging instruments to collect subsurface and surface data. These aircraft represent a significant advancement in Mars exploration methodology and robotic reconnaissance capabilities.

science-space.title: Antenna Testing for NASA's SkyFall Mission
science-space.summary: NASA engineers at the Jet Propulsion Laboratory are conducting rigorous electromagnetic testing on ground-penetrating radar antennas for the SkyFall mission to ensure optimal performance on Mars. These technical preparations are critical to the mission's success in collecting subsurface geological data.

science-space.title: Exploring 'very low Earth orbit': The world's 1st air-breathing satellite thruster could soon get a test run
science-space.summary: Innovative air-breathing electric propulsion technology is poised to enable satellites to operate in very low Earth orbit, a frontier previously inaccessible due to atmospheric drag. This breakthrough could extend satellite operational lifespans and open new possibilities for orbital applications.

science-space.title: Educators & Teens Get Hands-On With TEMPO Data to Help Investigate Local Air Quality
science-space.summary: NASA's CosmicDS project partnered with the Smithsonian Institution to provide educators and students with authentic NASA air quality data for hands-on scientific investigation. science-space.title: I Am Artemis: Tom Percy
science-space.summary: Tom Percy, manager of systems engineering and integration for NASA's Human Landing System Program, plays a key role in coordinating the Artemis mission planning with partners like SpaceX. science-space.title: AI agents are checking the scientific literature — and spotting decades-old errors
science-space.summary: Artificial intelligence systems are now being deployed to systematically review scientific literature and identify errors that have persisted for decades. This application of AI represents a major advancement in scientific quality control and the self-correction of the scientific record.

science-space.title: Operational Tropical Cyclone Forecasting with AI
science-space.summary: Artificial intelligence systems are being integrated into operational weather forecasting to improve tropical cyclone prediction and early warning systems. This technology enhances meteorological accuracy and potentially saves lives through better disaster preparedness.

science-space.title: Briefing Chat: Is DNA repair the secret to a long life? Whales and mole rats offer tantalizing hints
science-space.summary: Research examining DNA repair mechanisms in long-lived animals such as whales and mole rats provides new insights into the biological foundations of longevity. These findings may inform future strategies for understanding aging and extending healthy human lifespan.

finance-markets.title: Oil Gains as Iran Deal Eludes, Asian Stocks Rise: Markets Wrap
finance-markets.summary: Oil prices extended gains as negotiations between Iran and the US over reopening the Strait of Hormuz remained stalled, while Asian equity markets rose. The geopolitical uncertainty continues to support crude valuations amid broader market movements.

finance-markets.title: Gold Holds Gain After Soft US Jobs Data Eases Rate-Hike Concerns
finance-markets.summary: Gold maintained its position following a significant weekly gain as softer-than-expected US employment data reduced expectations for near-term interest rate increases. The precious metal benefited from dovish monetary policy signals embedded in the labor market weakness.

finance-markets.title: Investors return to European stocks as strong earnings lift Iran war gloom
finance-markets.summary: European equities attracted renewed investor interest as companies in the Stoxx Europe 600 index demonstrated robust earnings momentum, with second-quarter profits on track for a 22% increase. finance-markets.title: S&P 500 futures slip as traders watch for Strait of Hormuz deal, inflation data: Live updates
finance-markets.summary: S&P 500 futures declined as market participants monitored negotiations over the Strait of Hormuz and awaited key inflation data, following a strong weekly performance that brought the index to an all-time closing high. Geopolitical and macroeconomic developments remained focal points for equity traders.

finance-markets.title: US social security could soon be insolvent
finance-markets.summary: The Social Security system faces potential insolvency in the near term, raising critical questions about the long-term sustainability of the program and whether Congress will enact necessary reforms. The fiscal challenge underscores broader concerns about demographic trends and entitlement spending in the United States.

finance-markets.summary: The Australian dollar is positioned to climb toward a 35-year high against the Japanese yen as the effects of Tokyo's currency intervention diminish and the Reserve Bank of Australia maintains its hawkish monetary policy stance. Currency strategists cite growing interest rate differentials as a primary driver of the appreciation trend.

finance-markets.title: Treasury Wine Shares Soar After Moves to Tackle Excess US Supply
finance-markets.summary: Treasury Wine Estates' stock surged to an eight-month high following the Australian vintner's announcement of a A$558.4 million post-tax writedown aimed at addressing supply chain challenges in the US market. The restructuring move signals management's commitment to resolving operational inefficiencies and improving profitability.

finance-markets.title: Westpac Shares Drop on Signs of Australia Housing Slowdown
finance-markets.summary: Westpac Banking Corp.'s share price declined after the Australian lender reported a contraction in mortgage loan applications, signaling an intensification of the domestic housing downturn. The weak lending activity reflects broader headwinds in Australia's residential real estate market and consumer confidence.

finance-markets.title: China Bets on AI Stocks as It Races Against US for Chip, Tech Dominance
finance-markets.summary: China is shifting its competitive strategy by focusing investment on artificial intelligence stocks rather than relying exclusively on traditional subsidies and state funding mechanisms. This strategic pivot reflects Beijing's determination to compete with the United States in high-technology sectors and semiconductor capabilities.

tech-ai.summary: The AI-focused hedge fund Situational Awareness is making a substantial $400 million investment in chip startup Source Foundry, signaling confidence in semiconductor innovation despite ongoing challenges. tech-ai.summary: A security researcher has developed an algorithm that generates computer-generated patterns capable of rendering people, faces, and vehicles undetectable by surveillance cameras. startups-vc.title: Defense tech Hadrian raises $1.37B at $8B valuation

startups-vc.summary: Paysend CEO Ben Chisell argues that product management experience provides equally relevant leadership preparation as traditional executive titles like COO or CFO, which typically receive more focus in CEO succession research. energy-climate.summary: The Trump administration announced sweeping new tariffs on imported polysilicon and solar panels, which are expected to raise installation costs while promoting domestic solar manufacturing. The policy marks a significant shift in trade approach that could reshape the U.S. solar market.

energy-climate.title: Q&A: Does the world need 'carbon capture and storage' to reach net-zero?
energy-climate.summary: The article examines the role of carbon capture and storage technology in achieving net-zero emissions targets, analyzing whether this approach is essential or complementary to other decarbonization strategies. Expert analysis addresses both the potential and limitations of CCS deployment.

energy-climate.title: The Pentagon's wind farm blockade is over — for now
energy-climate.summary: A federal judge has ordered the Department of Defense to resume routine military evaluations of proposed onshore wind farms after months of de facto refusal. The ruling removes a significant regulatory barrier to wind energy development at a time of rising electricity demand.

energy-climate.title: Facing an estimated 474 GW of interconnection requests, Texas hits pause on data centers
energy-climate.summary: Texas Governor Greg Abbott has called for an audit of data centers in the ERCOT interconnection queue, forcing a delay in batch processing as the grid operator grapples with a massive 474 GW of pending connection requests. The pause reflects growing tensions over electricity demand from data centers and grid reliability.

energy-climate.title: Duke Energy to issue $10B in equity to capture gas generation growth opportunity
energy-climate.summary: Duke Energy plans to issue $10 billion in equity and deploy over $1 billion monthly to capitalize on record electricity demand, with expansion focused on gas generation. However, North Carolina advocates contend the utility has overstated growth projections to justify the aggressive spending plan.

energy-climate.title: Analysis: 84% of nations miss deadline to identify 'nature-harming' subsidies by 2025
energy-climate.summary: The vast majority of countries failed to meet a 2025 deadline to identify subsidies harmful to biodiversity, revealing weak implementation of commitments made at international environmental conferences. The missed target highlights persistent challenges in aligning economic incentives with conservation goals.

energy-climate.title: California DER wholesale market participation could grow 2+ GW from CAISO 'accounting change': advocate
energy-climate.summary: California's distributed energy resources, including behind-the-meter batteries and aggregators, could see additional market opportunities worth more than 2 GW through a proposed accounting change by grid operator CAISO. Related rulemaking at the California Public Utilities Commission may further support DER participation, though a final ruling is not expected until 2026.

asia-pacific.title: Indonesia's strong GDP data prompts 'resilient but uneven' growth forecasts
asia-pacific.summary: Indonesia's economy grew 5.29 percent year-on-year in the second quarter, exceeding expectations and signaling potential economic recovery for Southeast Asia's largest economy. Analysts caution that growth remains uneven across sectors with heavy reliance on government spending, warranting careful monitoring of the economic outlook.

asia-pacific.title: Why Malaysia's political turmoil matters to Beijing
asia-pacific.summary: Malaysia's political instability presents challenges for China's efforts to reshape the global order and assert itself as more reliable than the United States amid shifting international perceptions. The case illustrates potential obstacles Beijing may encounter in advancing its geopolitical influence in Southeast Asia.

asia-pacific.title: Historian Wang Gungwu on US credibility and why Xi thinks 'only the party can save China'
asia-pacific.summary: Renowned historian Wang Gungwu discusses evolving perceptions of US credibility and China's strategic positioning under President Xi Jinping in an interview addressing broader geopolitical shifts. The commentary from the prominent scholar provides insight into Beijing's ideological foundations and international strategy.

asia-pacific.title: Iran Guards say will not reopen Hormuz without US meeting Tehran's demands
asia-pacific.summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guards have signaled they will not reopen the Strait of Hormuz unless the United States meets Tehran's demands, escalating tensions over one of the world's critical shipping routes. The stance reflects ongoing geopolitical friction affecting regional stability and global energy markets.

asia-pacific.title: Singapore-registered firm used fake employees and recruitment methods mirroring foreign intelligence playbook
asia-pacific.summary: Singaporean authorities have identified Infoassa, a local firm employing deceptive recruitment practices and fake employees that mirror foreign intelligence tactics. The discovery raises concerns about espionage operations and covert influence activities operating within the Asia-Pacific region.

asia-pacific.title: Youth membership in Hong Kong uniformed groups drops 8% over 5 years
asia-pacific.summary: Hong Kong's uniformed youth groups have experienced an 8 percent membership decline over five years despite consistent government funding, attributable to low birth rates and expanding extracurricular options. The trend has prompted lawmakers to propose performance metrics to ensure effective allocation of public resources.

asia-pacific.title: Trump says US is 'low-keying it' with Iran, stresses economic pain
asia-pacific.summary: President Trump signaled a shift toward economic pressure rather than military action against Iran, suggesting a recalibration of US Middle East strategy. The approach reflects evolving diplomatic calculations regarding Iran negotiations amid broader regional conflicts.

asia-pacific.title: Asia stocks edge higher, oil up amid Gulf confusion
asia-pacific.summary: Asian equity markets recorded modest gains while oil prices strengthened amid ongoing uncertainty in the Persian Gulf region. The movement reflects investor response to geopolitical tensions affecting energy supplies and regional stability.

asia-pacific.title: Oil rises as uncertainty continues over reopening of Strait
asia-pacific.summary: Oil prices advanced as uncertainty persists regarding reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, a critical global energy chokepoint. The situation underscores how regional geopolitical tensions directly impact international commodity markets and energy security.

asia-pacific.title: Russia and Ukraine exchange overnight strikes that leave 7 dead, many injured
asia-pacific.summary: Russia and Ukraine conducted simultaneous strikes killing civilians and wounding dozens on both sides, continuing patterns of escalating military operations. The attacks highlight Ukraine's ongoing air defense challenges and Russia's tactical exploitation of limited interceptor availability.
